title: Counting-down song with seeded words
notes: S1-E-PY. EvoEval-style mutation: d2 seeded object, colour, place phrase, verb and maximum (12..20) with exact line templates, singular/no forms and ValueError on bad start/take; d3 + k (2 or 3) items fall per verse, fewer when fewer remain; d4 + a seeded refrain line after the second line of every verse with an even starting count. Difficulty guess for deepseek-flash: medium (d3).
